title: He Insulted My Mom's Cooking… Then SHE Walked In 🤖 Ep.1

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lunch break. Room twelve. [beat] And Bruno was about to make the biggest mistake of his school year.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Ohhhhh… here we go again. Open the lid, curry boy. [beat] Let the whole class enjoy the smell.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It's my mom's kacchi biryani, Bruno. [beat] She wakes up at five… every single morning… [beat] to make it. For me.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Five a.m.? [beat] For THIS? Bro… [beat] she should've slept in and ordered a pizza.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Yo… [beat] did he just disrespect your MOM? Right here?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Joy. Don't. [beat] He's not worth it.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Awww, listen to him… protecting mommy's little recipe. [beat] Walk. Away. [beat] Curry. Boy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now… here's the thing about our school. [beat] The hallway behind room twelve has exactly one blind spot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And in that blind spot… [beat] stood Principal Huda.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: P—Principal Huda! Ma'am, I— [beat] we were just joking around!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Joking. About a mother. Who cooks at five in the morning. [beat] In MY hallway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The temperature dropped ten degrees. [beat] Even the ceiling fan slowed down.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Quiet, Nix. [beat] Bruno. Tomorrow. Lunch break. My office. [beat] Bring your appetite.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: My… appetite? [beat] Ma'am, what does that—

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Oh, Bruno knew exactly what it meant. [beat] And the whole school was about to find out.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for part two. [beat] Because what she did to him… became school legend.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Trust me… [beat] you were NOT ready for this punishment.
